content.text: @pi can you see what's in this image? pi-action-agent: ### 🤖 pi Response The retest worked: with pit **0.36.2**, `workspace.viewImage` attached the screenshot and I could see it. It's the same image as before: a dark-mode comment by **pi-action-agent** (Bot badge, "4m ago – with pi-action-agent"), a **🤖 pi Response** heading, and the cut-off line "I opened three issues, each written against a made-up repo…". I also opened the follow-up as **#71**, "feat: give pi-durable extensions an image processor". CI passes. I haven't merged it, since you only cv: @pi #71 merged. are we ready to close this issue? pi-action-agent: ### 🤖 pi Response Yes, I think we can close it. Everything this issue asked for now works on `main`, and I checked it again in this run. - **Seeing images:** with pit 0.36.2, `workspace.viewImage` attaches the screenshot from this issue and I can see it. - **Resizing large images (#71):** I made a 3000×3000 test PNG, a size the model won't accept as-is. `viewImage` attached it with "Resized from 3000x3000 to 2000x2000", so pit is using pi-action's image processor.
